feed.title: SHRINCS: an efficient hash-based signature scheme for Bitcoin (first draft)

entry.title: SHRINCS: an efficient hash-based signature scheme for Bitcoin (first draft)
entry.summary:
The acceptance of GFMD appears to be positive news, as noted in a specific issue tracked on GitHub ([Issue #21](https://github.com/SHRINCS/shrincs-bip/issues/21)). However, there's a plan to delay the submission of a pull request (PR) for the SHRINCS BIP draft into the BIPs repository. This postponement is intended to allow additional time to gather and review public feedback. This approach ensures that any necessary modifications can be identified and implemented based on the community's input before finalizing the draft.
Feedback from sources outside the main discussion thread has been pointed out as significant and worth considering. The links to this feedback are accessible at [x.com/P3b7_](https://x.com/P3b7_/status/2100243609861693898) and [x.com/projecteleven](https://x.com/projecteleven/status/2093450676529774992). These contributions are crucial as they might influence the proposed changes or enhancements to the SHRINCS BIP draft.
Overall, the process highlights a meticulous approach to integrating broad community insights and suggestions into the development and refinement of BIP drafts, ensuring that the changes are well-considered and supported by the community before formal integration into the repository.
